en.question: Would you rather be able to talk to animals or speak every human language?
followUps: Which animal would you talk to first?
What would you do with the power on an ordinary Tuesday?

es.question: ¿Qué preferís: poder hablar con los animales o hablar todos los idiomas del mundo?
followUps: ¿Qué harías con ese poder un martes cualquiera?

en.question: Would you rather be able to pause time or rewind it by ten seconds?
followUps: When last week would you have used it?
How long before someone caught on?

en.question: Would you rather always know when someone is lying, or always get away with lying yourself?
en.optionB: Always get away with a lie
followUps: Who would you test it on first?
Would it make your friendships better or worse?

en.question: If you could live one year of your life again, knowing what you know now, which year would you pick?
followUps: Would you risk changing everything that came after?

en.question: You get to add one new rule that everyone in the world must follow. What is it?
followUps: How would people try to get around it?
What happens to people who break it?

en.question: If you could instantly master any skill, but had to lose one you already have, what would you trade?
followUps: Which skill would you never give up?
Would anyone here notice the swap?

en.question: A genie grants you a superpower, but it only works on Mondays. Which one do you pick?
followUps: What would you do the rest of the week to get ready?

en.question: If a theme song played every time you walked into a room, what would yours be?
followUps: Which song would you hate to get stuck with?
Pick one for the person next to you.
